title: A marca da Estrela
logline: At a cattle auction, Cleide claims Rosa's dairy heifer is stolen to stop the sale that pays for the family land; Dr. Pelicioni predicts where she will say she branded it, and her lie becomes the proof.
style: Cinematic live action, camera-ready faces in soft, bright, flattering light from the scene's own sources, natural colour.

asked.from: Editor: dialogue in Brazilian Portuguese; fixed cast and voices (ELENCO_FIXO.md); 720p; cap 700 credits

screenplay:
TITLE: A MARCA DA ESTRELA
Runtime: ~78 s | Locations: a cattle auction ring in the São Paulo countryside | Cast: Rosa (protagonist), Cleide (antagonist), Valdir (antagonist), Doutor Pelicioni (protector), Auctioneer (auctioneer), Bruna (ally) + buyers in the bleachers

— CLIP k1 (0:00–0:15) — l1 —

HOOK (0:00)
Rosa stands in the sand ring holding the rope of Estrela, a spotted dairy heifer. In the bleachers, Cleide springs up and points at the heifer.

CLEIDE
Essa vaca é roubada! É minha!

Rosa lifts her chin toward the bleachers.

ROSA
É a Estrela. Criei na mamadeira.

Valdir, seated beside Cleide, laughs.

VALDIR
Pobre assim, com vaca de doze mil?

[INSERT: the small R hot-iron brand on the left side of Estrela's neck, Rosa's hand on the rope below it.]

FRICTION (0:12)
Rosa presses her lips together and holds Cleide's look.

— CLIP k2 (0:15–0:30) — l1 —

JOLT 1 (0:15)
Rosa turns to the auctioneer at his wooden pulpit.

ROSA
Doze mil ajuda no depósito da terra.

Cleide turns to the buyers, smiling.

CLEIDE
Essa aí não tem onde cair morta.

The auctioneer lowers his microphone.

AUCTIONEER
Dona Rosa, com acusação eu tiro o lote.

Rosa's hand tightens on the rope.

— CLIP k3 (0:30–0:45) — l1 —

Cleide comes down two steps to the ring's fence.

CLEIDE
Cadê a nota dela? Cadê o papel?

Rosa's eyes fill.

ROSA
O papel ficou em casa. Deus sabe.

Valdir stands up beside the fence.

VALDIR
Roça de pobre não cria vaca assim.

JOLT 2 (0:42)
At the black iron gate, Bruna appears, out of breath.

— CLIP k4 (0:45–1:00) — l1 —

VALDIR
Chama a polícia. Ladra não sai daqui.

Doutor Pelicioni walks in through the gate behind Bruna and stops beside Rosa. He looks only at Cleide.

DOUTOR PELICIONI
Ela vai dizer que marcou na anca.

CLEIDE
Marquei na anca, sim! Pode olhar!

SPIKE (0:56)
Rosa pulls the rope and turns Estrela: her hip is clean, no brand.

— CLIP k5 (1:00–1:18) — l1 —

[INSERT: the small R hot-iron brand on the left side of Estrela's neck.]

DOUTOR PELICIONI
Na anca, a lei não deixa marcar.

Cleide's smile drops.

DOUTOR PELICIONI
E ladra, na frente de todos, é calúnia.

The auctioneer points Cleide and Valdir to the gate. They walk out.

CLEIDE
Vende a vaca. O pasto é nosso.

ENDING (1:12)
The auctioneer strikes his gavel on the pulpit. Rosa strokes Estrela's neck over the R. Doutor Pelicioni stands beside her, looking at the gate.

CUT TO BLACK.

locations.description: a present-day small-town cattle auction ring in the São Paulo countryside, Brazil: a round ring of raked sand fenced with weathered wooden planks; a semicircle of wooden bleacher steps rising on one side, filled with buyers; a corrugated zinc roof on wooden beams; across the ring, the auctioneer's wooden pulpit with a microphone and a dark wooden gavel, and beside it a black iron gate, the ring's entrance
locations.light: late afternoon, warm golden sunlight slanting in through the gaps in the zinc roof, dust floating in the beams, faces lit soft and bright
